items.title: David Friesen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] It’s good to be here. Good to meet you, Monk.

ctx.x: David was interviewed via Zoom on September 24, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very happy to have bassist and composer David Friesen with me this afternoon. Welcome, and thanks, and congratulations on your career.
Well thank you very much. I have a little white sign on my iPhone now. I can’t see you at all. It says this meeting is being recorded.
